summary: Fail closed after hard xrReleaseSwapchainImage errors: retain local image ownership for transactional teardown, block further Acquire/re-render of the same waited image, and force EnsureSwapchain through Destroy/recreate.

C1_REVIEW.evidence: R19 already failed closed for non-timeout wait errors, but xrReleaseSwapchainImage hard failure left acquired=true/waited=true with no fault marker, allowing the same waited image to be rendered and release-retried on later frames. OpenXR 1.1.63 defines hard release errors including call-order, handle, runtime, instance and session failures.

standards: OpenXR 1.1.63 xrReleaseSwapchainImage requires a successfully waited image and reports hard failures including XR_ERROR_CALL_ORDER_INVALID, XR_ERROR_HANDLE_INVALID, XR_ERROR_RUNTIME_FAILURE and XR_ERROR_SESSION_LOST.
XR_SUCCESS and XR_SESSION_LOSS_PENDING are success results; existing XR_SUCCEEDED handling is preserved.
